_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#3. Dropping the <linear_solver type="bicgstab"/> child from <solver type="thermo-fluid"> leaves the skyline default, the deck still reads SUCCESS, and the run then aborts with the matrix-format ERROR box and zero completed steps. Matched on the fragment 'does not support the requested' because the box wraps at 71 columns. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
